objective: Evaluate the locally generated released MiniMax-H3 Base checkpoint on the executable public Sci-VBench testmini VT protocol. This is a checkpoint benchmark observation, not a paper-wide judge-metric reproduction or training evidence.

public_inputs.joined_identity: each testmini id has exactly one author MiniMax-H3 settings sidecar; prompts match the published settings

frozen_generation_protocol.prompt: exact author settings prompt per matching testmini id
frozen_generation_protocol.resume_rule: skip only directories with a completed final status, decodable MP4 and SHA-256 inventory; never silently regenerate a completed ID

evaluation_protocol.reference_comparison: published MiniMax-H3 testmini VT aggregate 0.73460 and evaluator replay 0.735706; score comparison only after all 150 local media are complete

stopping_rules: First run one author-settings smoke; do not launch the remaining 149 if its payload, media contract or provenance fails.
Stop on first non-terminal API failure, service health failure or output identity mismatch; preserve error evidence and do not silently retry.
Do not evaluate incomplete media as a 150-video aggregate.
Do not report PG/SCC/SC/LPF: the paper judge model/protocol is not locally closed.
interpretation_rules: A full VT result is a settings-matched local checkpoint observation, not a proof that author code, hardware, seeds or all evaluation dimensions match.
Do not call numerical proximity to the published VT aggregate a full paper reproduction.
No training is authorized by this benchmark run.
